# WhiteSur Kvantum base

`WhiteSur*.kvconfig` and `WhiteSur*.svg` are copied unmodified from the WhiteSur-kde theme by
vinceliuice (https://github.com/vinceliuice/WhiteSur-kde), licensed GPL-3.0.

`theme/generators/build_kvantum.py` recolors them with the Aether palette to produce the
AetherGlass and AetherSerenity Kvantum themes. They provide the rounded, translucent widget
geometry; nothing else from WhiteSur is used.
